slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pain after a crash or fall

caption:
Lulu drives about three hours a day between job sites, and something keeps jabbing between her shoulder blades.

Hours in one position, the same arm reach and road vibration can leave the mid-back stiff and achy. It's usually about staying still too long, not damage to your spine.

Sit right back in the seat, bring it close enough for softly bent elbows, and add a rolled towel behind your lower back. Every two hours, stop: walk, reach overhead, squeeze your shoulder blades back and gently rotate each way.

Chest pain, breathlessness, fever, pain after a crash or constant pain worse at night need a doctor promptly. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🚗
